headline: Stylam Industries discloses substantial acquisition under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Stylam Industries has disclosed a substantial acquisition of shares triggering Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, filed with NSE on 19 June 2026.
detail: Stylam Industries Limited submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations to the National Stock Exchange. This regulation mandates disclosure when a party acquires 25% or more of voting capital, or acquires control. The filing date of 19 June 2026 indicates the acquisition was completed or announced in that period. Full details of the acquirer, consideration and shareholding structure will be available in the detailed SEBI Form under Regulation 31.
